name: Grace

description.en: A friendly regular. Patient and chatty.
description.vi: Khách quen thân thiện. Kiên nhẫn, thích trò chuyện.

wants: A classic manicure with round nails in a warm coral, nothing fancy. She is not in a hurry and her budget is about $35.
personality: Warm, patient and chatty, a retired teacher who loves hearing about the stylist's day. Easy to please; she thanks the stylist often and only gets cooler if she is ignored.
openingLine: Hello, dear! I'm here for my manicure. No rush at all, I've got the whole afternoon.
